title: Classify service errors across a bounded state transition
description: Introduce a bounded cross-cutting error-classification behavior at a service boundary, covering the new classification, two regressions that must remain unchanged, and an unknown-input edge case.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: The service classifies the new error category at its boundary.
AC2: An existing error category regression is preserved unchanged.
AC3: A second nearby regression category is preserved unchanged.
AC4: Unknown or empty input yields a safe default classification.
